stories.story_fr: Les ventes nettes ont diminué de 4 % pour atteindre 2,4 milliards de dollars.
Le bénéfice avant intérêts et impôts (EBIT) a progressé de 48 % pour atteindre 239 millions de dollars.
stories.story_en: Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT) increased to $239 million.
stories.quote: Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT) increased to $239 million

stories.story_fr: Les retards d'expédition liés à la tempête de janvier ont affecté les ventes nettes d'environ 1 % et l'EBIT ajusté d'environ 14 millions de dollars.
stories.story_en: January storm-related shipment delays and associated supply chain costs impacted net sales by approximately 1%, adjusted EBIT by approximately $14 million.
stories.quote: January storm-related shipment delays and associated supply chain costs impacted net sales by approximately 1%, adjusted EBIT by approximately $14 million

stories.story_fr: La marque Rao’s a dépassé le milliard de dollars de ventes nettes sur douze mois glissants.
stories.story_en: Rao’s brand surpassing $1 billion in trailing twelve-month net sales.
stories.quote: Rao’s brand surpassing $1 billion in trailing twelve-month net sales
